text:
sneha: quick triage note — new int4 bundle on raven-lite streaming has a spike in funcall parse errors, but the payloads look like they contain an embedded BOM or 0x00 separators in the middle of the JSON stream. seen on ~8% of short-stream traffic.

ram: repro logs?

sneha: uploaded two raw captures to s3://canary/traces/1612345678. example bytes (hex): `ef bb bf 7b 22 61 63 74 69 6f 6e 22 3a 22 6f 70 65 6e 22 7d 00 0a` which decodes to `\uFEFF{"action":"open"}\x00\n`. parser refuses.

rachel: interesting — BOM at start + null separator after the object. streaming muxer probably wrote a separator for chunk boundary but kernel kept BOM when re-encoding chunk boundaries.

ken: canary-bot says failures concentrated on streaming routes with keepalive & batch_size=1. non-streaming (sync) calls unaffected.

canary-bot: deploy raven-lite-int4-stream-canary @ 1612343000 -> hosts x,y. 22 successes / 2 failures in last 10m. failure_ids: cnry-1612345601, cnry-1612345899.

rachel: quick mitigation idea: in the stream consumer, when strict JSON parse fails, run sanitizer that: 1) drop leading BOM (0xEFBBBF) 2) remove isolated 0x00 separators between complete JSON tokens (but preserve if inside quoted strings). do this only as rescue.

marta: sound plan but regexes that try to preserve quoted strings are tricky. prefer to run a small stateful cleaner that scans bytes and drops 0x00/0x1E only when not inside string, using a simple state machine. add telemetry tag `rescue=bom_null_strip`.

ken: also add a guard: if cleaner modifies >10% of payload bytes, fail fast and route to a mirror queue for manual review — don't autocorrect huge corruption.

tom: for root cause, i can reproduce locally: running the quant kernel with chunked stdout + tokenizer flush emits BOM on first chunk when tokenizer resets; then our stream demux inserts 0x00 separators between chunks. combined effect yields `BOM + json + 0x00` when the model returns a single short object. i filed quant ticket QNT-459.

marta: action items: tom to add minimal reproducible test harness & link to QNT-459, rachel to prototype the stateful byte-cleaner in the call-rescue layer (feature flag), ken to add alert if rescue rate >3% for 30m, sneha to run 12h opt-in canary with rescue flag and compare functional correctness vs golden set.

rachel: small snippet for cleaner loop i'll push as PoC: ``for b in payload_bytes: if b==0xEF and next2==[0xBB,0xBF] and not inside_string: skip 3 bytes; elif b==0x00 and not inside_string: skip; else append b``. obviously needs robust utf8 checks.

tom: quant team note: likely fast fix in kernel re-encode path to not emit BOM and to use 0x1E as explicit record separator instead of 0x00. we'll try to land a patch this week.

ken: evaluation: run golden funcall correctness on 1k sampled requests with and without sanitizer to ensure no behavioral drift; if differences >0.2% pause auto-rescue.

sneha: timeline: rachel PoC today, ken monitoring + alert tomorrow, tom PR to quant this week. i'll coordinate the soft-canary once rescue feature flag is ready. thanks. :party-parrot:
